title: Reputation System
content: Reputation levels run Hated, Hostile, Unfriendly, Neutral, Friendly, Honored, Revered, Exalted. Quartermasters sell more as you climb; humans gain 10% extra, and this realm gives five times the normal reputation from every source.

title: Auction House
content: Every faction capital has an Auction House, such as Stormwind's Trade District and Orgrimmar's Valley of Strength, and so do Booty Bay, Gadgetzan and Everlook; Dalaran and Shattrath have none. Auctions last 12, 24 or 48 hours, the deposit is lost if the item doesn't sell, and the house keeps 15% of a sale.

title: Pet System
content: Hunters learn Tame Beast and Feed Pet at level 10 and keep beasts as permanent combat pets; Beast Mastery hunters can also tame exotic beasts. Feed Pet takes a food the beast eats, such as meat, fish or bread, and keeps it happy, and an unhappy pet deals less damage. Warlocks summon demons, Death Knights raise a ghoul and frost mages get a Water Elemental. Non-combat companion pets are purely cosmetic followers. Stable masters hold the beasts a hunter isn't using.

title: Need, Greed and Disenchant Rolls
content: When a loot roll pops up, each player picks Need, Greed, Disenchant or Pass within 60 seconds, and the server rolls a random 1 to 100 for everyone who chose. Any Need beats every Greed, so Need is for gear you will actually use; Disenchant shows only when someone in the group has Enchanting skill high enough for the item, and it ranks with Greed. In Dungeon Finder groups you can only Need gear your class can use. /roll gives a random 1 to 100 on its own.

title: Bind on Pickup and Bind on Equip
content: Bind on Pickup (BoP) items become soulbound the moment you loot or receive them, and can't be traded, mailed or auctioned, only sold to a vendor. Bind on Equip (BoE) items stay tradable until you equip them, and Bind on Use items bind when used. Bind to Account (BoA) items, mostly heirlooms, can be mailed between your own characters but never traded to anyone else. Here, soulbound gear that dropped for a group can still be traded to players who could have looted it, for 2 hours of played time.
